content: EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED: shap 0.52.0 (requires Python>=3.12, numpy>=2) + scikit-learn 1.9.0 + numpy 2.4.6 on Python 3.12.4 -- shap.TreeExplainer(RandomForestRegressor) computes SHAP values correctly. Recommended pattern for this project: linearmodels.PanelOLS is NOT sklearn-compatible and has no simple SHAP explainer support, so fit a SEPARATE auxiliary tree-based sklearn model (RandomForestRegressor or HistGradientBoostingRegressor, both built into scikit-learn, no new dependency) on the same panel features purely for shap.TreeExplainer interpretability, used as a corroborating/exploratory analysis alongside (not replacing) the PanelOLS causal fixed-effects results.
